action.message:
Implemented the feature contract: wrapped the Changelist `list_editable` POST processing in `ModelAdmin.changelist_view` (django/contrib/admin/options.py) with `transaction.atomic(using=router.db_for_write(self.model))`.

Details:
- The `transaction` and `router` modules were already imported (`from django.db import models, router, transaction`), so no import changes were needed.
- The atomic block now encloses the loop that saves each changed form (save_form/save_model/save_related/log_change), so any error during bulk list-editable edits rolls back the whole batch instead of leaving partial state.
- The success message and redirect remain outside the atomic block, preserving existing behavior.

Verification: ran scoped_tests — public regression selection `admin_changelist` passed (74 tests, 0 failures). Only the allowed file was edited; no tests or docs were modified.
